name: robotics/fleet-member
definition: Subject belongs to the named fleet.
data-schema: fleet-member-data = { * tstr => any }   ; free map, recommended: fleet: tstr
title: Fleet member
description: Minimum claim for ATEP-R telemetry and coordination commands, together with sensor-source for sensor data, and with peer-motion for delegated motion. Safety e-stops are accepted from a fleet-member that is also safety-certified.
subject: Agent ID of the unit
attestation-schema:
attestation = {
  subject: agent-id,
  issuer: agent-id,                      ; MUST equal the envelope signer
  claim: uri,
  data: { * tstr => any },
  ? evidence: bstr .size 32,
  ? evidence-uri: uri,
  id: bstr .size 16,
}
agent-id = bstr .size 32
uri = tstr
lifetime: 30 to 180 days by default, 400 days at most
